notes: No design is named; cross-sectional is inferred from aggregated monthly EHR queries. CIs for mean relative disparities are reported, but conclusions rest on the named t-tests, so no CI-inversion test is added. Analyses are unadjusted (aggregate data), as the limitations state.
view_issues: Discussion says Black and Asian inpatients received dexamethasone less often, but Table 2 race disparities for dexamethasone are not significant (p t 0.50, 0.78). Results text on dexamethasone temporal differences is garbled ('among White inpatients and Black, and Asian inpatients'). Article was corrected after publication.
